title: Minimum Cost to Convert String III
summary: Transform source into target using matching substring-replacement rules of equal pattern/replacement length. A pattern '*' matches any one character. Applying a rule costs its listed cost plus its wildcard count. Each character position may be used in at most one application, so applications cannot overlap or rewrite already-used positions. Return minimum cost, or -1 if impossible.
officialConstraints: Equal lowercase input lengths1..5000; 1..200 rules; rule length1..20, at least one literal lowercase pattern letter and at most5 wildcards; replacements lowercase; base costs1..1000.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
